title: webdav — pacote R (CRAN)
text: Política de erros: argumento inválido → cli_abort; falha de rede ou servidor → cli_warn + retorno FALSE (NULL em webdav_list_files). Status HTTP tratado explicitamente com req_error(is_error = ~FALSE) e mensagens com resp_status_desc(). O operador %||% é definido em R/utils.R (base R só o tem partir 4.4.0; o pacote declara R >= 4.1). Upload/download são streaming (req_body_file() / req_perform(path=) com tempfile + rename); não carregar corpo em memória. Header Destination (COPY/MOVE) sempre passa por httpuv::encodeURI, igual à URL da requisição.

title: Get Started
text: function creates basic authenticated WebDAV request given resource path WebDAV server. sets authentication using provided username password returns request object. Parameters: base_url: Base URL WebDAV server (e.g., https://drive.expresso.pe.gov.br). username: Username authentication. password: Password authentication. verbose: Whether print debug information (default FALSE). Example:
code: webdav_create_request(base_url, username, password, verbose = FALSE) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # Create a request if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   req <- webdav_create_request(base_url = test_server$url, verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started
text: function copies file directory one path another WebDAV server. Parameters: base_url: Base URL WebDAV server. from_path: source file path copy. to_path: destination path file copied. username: Username authentication. password: Password authentication. overwrite: TRUE (default), existing resource to_path overwritten. Example:
code: webdav_copy_file(base_url, from_path, to_path, username, password, overwrite = TRUE) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # Copy a file from one path to another if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_copy_file(base_url = test_server$url,     from_path = "Project.pdf",     to_path = "New_Project.pdf",     verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started
text: function moves (renames) file directory WebDAV server using MOVE method. Moving within folder renames resource. Parameters: base_url: Base URL WebDAV server. from_path: source file path move. to_path: destination path resource. username: Username authentication. password: Password authentication. overwrite: TRUE (default), existing resource to_path overwritten. Example:
code: webdav_move_file(base_url, from_path, to_path, username, password, overwrite = TRUE) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # Rename a file on the WebDAV server if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_move_file(base_url = test_server$url,     from_path = "Notes.txt",     to_path = "Notes-renamed.txt",     verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started

code: webdav_create_directory(base_url, folder_path, username, password) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # Create a directory on the WebDAV server if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_create_directory(     base_url = test_server$url,      folder_path = "Test_Folder",      verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started
text: function deletes file directory WebDAV server using DELETE method. Parameters: 1. base_url: Base URL WebDAV server. 1. resource_path: path file directory delete. 1. username: Username authentication. 1. password: Password authentication. Example:

title: Get Started
text: function lists files within directory WebDAV server using PROPFIND method. Parameters: base_url: Base URL WebDAV server. folder_path: Path folder list files. username: Username authentication. password: Password authentication. depth: Depth PROPFIND request (default 1). Example:
code: webdav_list_files(   base_url,    folder_path,    username,    password,    depth = 1,    verbose = FALSE   ) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # List files in a directory if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_list_files(     base_url = test_server$url,      folder_path = "Sales/",      verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started
text: function uploads local file WebDAV server. Parameters: base_url: Base URL WebDAV server. local_path: Local path file. server_path: Path WebDAV server file uploaded. username: Username authentication. password: Password authentication. timeout: Time limit upload operation (default 300 seconds). Example:
code: webdav_upload_file(   base_url,    local_path,    server_path,    username,    password,    timeout = 300,   verbose = FALSE   ) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform() %>%   try(silent = TRUE)  # Upload a file file_test <- tempfile(pattern = "teste_", fileext = ".txt") cat("Text file content", file = file_test) if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_upload_file(base_url = test_server$url, local_path = file_test, verbose = TRUE)

title: Get Started
text: function downloads file WebDAV server saves local directory. validates provided parameters, handles errors, optionally prints detailed logs requested. Parameters: base_url: base URL WebDAV server. file_path: path file WebDAV server download (relative ‘base_url’). destination_path: local directory downloaded file saved. Defaults current directory. username: username WebDAV authentication. Defaults “WEBDAV_USERNAME” environment variable. password: password WebDAV authentication. Defaults “WEBDAV_PASSWORD” environment variable. verbose: Logical. TRUE, prints detailed messages download process. Example:
code: webdav_download_file(base_url, file_path, destination_path, username, password, verbose) # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. library(magrittr) library(httr2) test_server <- "https://www.webdavserver.com/" %>%   request() %>%   req_retry(max_tries = 3, max_seconds = 4, backoff =  ~ 1) %>%   req_perform()  # Download a file from the WebDAV server if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_download_file(base_url = test_server$url,     file_path = "Project.pdf",     destination_path = tempdir(),     verbose = TRUE) # Visit test_server$url to view the results of the operation.

title: List files from a specific folder on WebDAV server — webdav_list_files
text: base_url base URL WebDAV server. folder_path path inside WebDAV files located. provided empty, root folder listed. username username WebDAV authentication. Defaults "WEBDAV_USERNAME" environment variable. password password WebDAV authentication. Defaults "WEBDAV_PASSWORD" environment variable. depth depth PROPFIND request (default 1). verbose Logical value indicating whether print detailed debug messages. TRUE, function outputs additional information progress actions.

title: List files from a specific folder on WebDAV server — webdav_list_files
text: tibble containing: display_name name file directory. full_path full URL (href) resource. creation_date date resource created. last_modified date resource last modified. content_length size resource bytes (NA directories). is_folder Logical indicating whether resource directory. code: webdav_move_file(   base_url,   from_path,   to_path,   username = Sys.getenv("WEBDAV_USERNAME"),   password = Sys.getenv("WEBDAV_PASSWORD"),   overwrite = TRUE,   verbose = FALSE )

title: Move or rename a resource on the WebDAV server — webdav_move_file
text: base_url base URL WebDAV server. from_path source path resource move. to_path destination path resource. Moving within folder renames resource. username username WebDAV authentication. Defaults "WEBDAV_USERNAME" environment variable. password password WebDAV authentication. Defaults "WEBDAV_PASSWORD" environment variable. overwrite Logical. TRUE (default, matching WebDAV protocol default), existing resource `to_path` overwritten. verbose Logical. TRUE, prints detailed messages move process.

title: Move or rename a resource on the WebDAV server — webdav_move_file
text: `TRUE` resource moved successfully, `FALSE` (warning) otherwise. Invalid arguments raise error.

title: Move or rename a resource on the WebDAV server — webdav_move_file
code: # Example usage with a public WebDAV server. # Visit test_server$url link to view the results of the operation. library(httr2) test_server <- "http://webdavserver.net/" |>   request() |>   req_retry(max_tries = 1, max_seconds = 2, backoff =  ~ 1) |>   req_perform() |>   try(silent = TRUE)  # Rename a file on the WebDAV server if (!inherits(test_server, "try-error"))   webdav_move_file(base_url = test_server$url,     from_path = "Notes.txt",     to_path = "Notes-renamed.txt",     verbose = TRUE) #> ℹ Base URL: <http://webdavserver.net/User871f21d> #> ℹ Moving from: Notes.txt to: Notes-renamed.txt #> ℹ Source Path: <http://webdavserver.net/User871f21d/Notes.txt> #> ℹ Destination Path: #>   <http://webdavserver.net/User871f21d/Notes-renamed.txt> #> ℹ Base URL: <http://webdavserver.net/User871f21d/Notes.txt> #> ℹ Username: "Not provided" #> ✔ Request object created successfully. #> ! title: webdav 0.3.0
text: New webdav_move_file() moves renames file directory server using WebDAV MOVE method, overwrite argument. webdav_copy_file() gained overwrite argument (default TRUE, matching WebDAV protocol default).

title: webdav 0.3.0
text: Error handling now consistent across functions: invalid arguments raise error, network server failures issue warning return FALSE (NULL webdav_list_files()). Previously, webdav_copy_file(), webdav_download_file() webdav_create_directory() aborted server failures. HTTP failures now produce precise messages status code description (e.g. “423 (Locked)”) instead generic transport error.

title: webdav 0.3.0
text: webdav_list_files() longer fails R < 4.4.0: %||% operator relied exists base R 4.4.0 onward, package now carries definition. webdav_list_files() now returns correct display_name values listed folder’s name contains regex metacharacters (e.g. "pasta (1)"); folder prefix removed fixed string instead regex. webdav_copy_file() now percent-encodes Destination header, copying paths spaces non-ASCII characters works. request URL already encoded; header sent raw. webdav_upload_file() now prints “root” (instead empty path) success message uploading server root.

title: webdav 0.3.0
text: webdav_download_file() streams response straight disk (via temporary file, failed request never leaves partial file behind) instead loading whole body memory, validates destination directory exists. webdav_upload_file() streams file disk httr2::req_body_file() instead reading entirely memory, uses httr2::req_timeout() timeout. PROPFIND response parser extracted internal function package now covered offline unit tests (tests/testthat/), including ownCloud-style IIS-style (isFolder) fixtures mocked-request tests every HTTP verb. Removed LazyData DESCRIPTION (package data directory).

title: webdav 0.2.0
text: check_and_load_package() now deprecated. required packages declared DESCRIPTION loaded automatically R. Calling function issue deprecation warning.

title: webdav 0.2.0
text: Migrated user-facing messages message() / stop() cli package (cli::cli_inform(), cli::cli_alert_success(), cli::cli_warn(), cli::cli_abort()), providing richer formatted output semantic markup URLs, file paths, argument names. Added cli Imports DESCRIPTION. Added httr2::resp_status() import NAMESPACE. Fixed handle_response() use httr2::resp_status() instead legacy response$status_code accessor (httr v1 syntax). Removed redundant runtime calls check_and_load_package() inside exported functions — dependencies declared Imports guaranteed available need manual loading.

title: webdav 0.2.0
text: Added Marcos Wasiliew, Carlos Amorim authors. Fixed Hugo Vasconcelos surname spelling.

title: webdav 0.1.6
text: Now dynamically detects uses correct XML namespace prefix server (d, D, ), preventing XPath errors like Undefined namespace prefix. Uses xml2::as_list() reliably parse XML response structure. Ensures content_length safely parsed padded NA missing (e.g., directories), preventing errors creating resulting tibble. Adds new field is_folder, correctly identifying whether resource directory. Improved documentation output consistency informative column names (e.g., display_name, full_path, creation_date, etc.).
